purpose: Test whether within-query elite-dispersion updates mediate the old boundary-data CartPole return loss. This is a causal mechanism control, not a new attack or defense validation.
operation: Call unchanged native optimize and native mean/dispersion update. In fixed_dispersion only, replace the returned updated dispersion with a clone of that query's native initial variance0.25. Preserve updated mean, bound-constrained sampling, best-candidate strict-improvement rule, warm start and all sampling/model calls.

historical_gate.diagnostic_stats_policy: Record exact and allclose checks for other observational covariance/eigenvalue/value summaries. Tiny allclose-only differences are disclosed; any difference beyond these fixed tolerances blocks the pair.
historical_gate.failure: Stop this native episode immediately and skip its fixed arm. Continue the already fixed remaining model/seed panel. An incomplete panel is not a task-loss verdict.

randomness: Seed exactly as the old runner: torch.manual_seed(seed), action_space.seed(seed+50000), legacy reset setting NumPy seed, ModelEnv generator seed+10000. Preserve the global Torch randperm used by GaussianMLP ensemble allocation and all native truncated-normal draws. Compare actual global-Torch and ModelEnv RNG entry/exit states at every shared query index; never reseed per query. Restore the same otherwise-unused Python random state before both arms.

negative_control.required: After exact native historical reconstruction, fixed must reproduce all200 real trajectory rows exactly. The saved native episode has a first-round score15 at every query; under unchanged RNG and best-solution warm starts, a dispersion-only later-round change cannot alter its actions.

runtime.qualification: This runtime previously loaded the same model family successfully, but the old covariance runs did not save their runtime. Exact historical reconstruction, not an assumed version match, qualifies each pair.

cost_basis.interpretation: An estimate before new logging/IO, not measured duration of the new24 episodes.

analysis: Report all four paired deltas per model and interactions delta_boundary-delta_random and delta_boundary-delta_interior. No posthoc effect threshold, significance test or new seed. Positive interaction alone is not selective recovery: controls can deteriorate and are often ceiling-censored. Distinguish stored optimizer dispersion from effective variance after mean-dependent action-bound constraints. Report all200-cap censoring: random and interior each reached the cap in3 of4 old episodes. Do not call positive relative interactions boundary-specific causality when comparison headroom differs. No CIs or ASR from dependent queries; no follow-up variance tuning.
scope: Three existing locally trained checkpoints, one task and four old development seeds; unchanged MBRL-Lib optimizer class under the old reduced100-candidate/3-iteration/best-candidate protocol, not the upstream-default stronger350/5/elite-mean setting. Positive results would support a local causal role, not establish novelty, an externally pretrained-system effect or a cost-free defense.

review.reviewed_by: root with two independent source reviews
review.user_authorization: Existing autonomous research goal; no additional user approval requested.
review.scientific_scope: One fixed local mediator control motivated by a newly identified mismatch between logged covariance and native returned-action provenance. No new seed, training, task or attack tuning.
